blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For the first time, the Philippine peso has dropped to the 63-per-dollar level even as the US dollar fell from an 18-month high despite hotter-than-expected US inflation. Data from the Bankers Association of the Philippines showed that the local currency fell to an intraday low of 63.06 against the dollar during morning trading.
